followup.title: Following up on your recent alert
followup.intro: You or the app flagged that you may need extra support. Here is where things stand.

status.openNotShared: Alert recorded. It was not shared with a counsellor.
status.handed_off: Your counsellor is arranging more support for you

statusHint.open: Alerts reach them inside the app. Nobody watches the app around the clock, so they may see it only the next time they sign in.
statusHint.acknowledged: They have it and will be in touch in their own time.
statusHint.contacted: Check your messages and appointments in the app.
statusHint.handed_off: Another person or service is picking this up with you.
statusHint.closed: You can still reach a counsellor or a helpline whenever you want to.

followup.notShared: No counsellor can see this alert, because you have not shared risk alerts with one. If you need support now, please call a helpline from this card.
followup.answeredOkay: Thanks for letting us know. If things change, you can answer a check-in again or call a helpline from this card.
followup.answeredTalk: Thank you. We have told your counsellor that you would like to talk. This is an in-app alert and may not be seen right away. If you need someone now, call a helpline from this card.
followup.answeredTalkNotShared: Thank you. Your answer is saved, but no counsellor can see it, because you have not shared risk alerts with one. If you need someone now, call a helpline from this card.
followup.answerError: We could not save your answer. Please try again, or call a helpline from this card.
followup.optOutError: We could not save that choice. Please try again.
followup.refreshError: Your action went through, but this card could not refresh. Reload the page to see the latest status.
followup.optOut: Do not show me future check-in questions on this device
followup.optOutHint: Your counsellor can still see your follow-up status, and the helplines on this card always stay here.
followup.offerAccepted: Session confirmed! Check your appointments tab for details.
followup.offerDeclined: Offer declined. You can still reach out or book a session whenever you're ready.
followup.offerError: We could not process the session offer. Please try again or call a helpline from this card.
followup.offerGone: This offer is no longer available, and nothing was booked. You can still reach out or call a helpline from this card.
followup.helplinesNote: Free, confidential, and answered by people. These are not part of this app.
followup.disclaimer: This is educational support, not a diagnosis or emergency service.
